text: Gazprom-group companies hold a majority of NIS a.d.: Gazprom Neft owns 44.85% of the shares and Gazprom a further 11.3% through Gazprom Capital, while the Serbian government holds 29.87%. The agreed sale of the Russian stake to Hungary's MOL had not closed as of 29 September 2026.
short: Gazprom Neft owns 44.85% of NIS and Gazprom 11.3% via Gazprom Capital; the MOL buyout has not closed.

source.name: AK&M Information Agency: Hungarian MOL and Serbian government sign NIS agreement
source.quote: Gazprom Neft currently owns 44.85% of NIS shares, Gazprom - 11.3% through Gazprom Capital (plus one share directly), the Government of Serbia — 29.87%

additionalSources.name: Srpske Novine (srpske.rs): Two GOP Lawmakers Urge Bessent to Deny NIS a New License
additionalSources.quote: Russian owners hold 56.15% of NIS, of which 44.85% belongs to Gazprom Neft. Hungary’s MOL announced in January that it had reached a deal with Gazprom Neft to take over its stake, but the transaction has not closed.
